title: Average Value of a Function over a Rectangle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the average value of f(x, y) = xy over the rectangle R = [0, 4] x [0, 2].

steps.title: Compute Area of Rectangle
steps.explanation: Multiply width by height of rectangle.

steps.title: Compute Double Integral of f
steps.mathExpression: \iint_R xy \, dA = \left( \int_0^4 x \, dx \right) \left( \int_0^2 y \, dy \right) = \left[ \frac{x^2}{2} \right]_0^4 \left[ \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_0^2 = (8)(2) = 16
steps.explanation: Evaluate product of decoupled polynomial integrals.

steps.title: Calculate Average Value
steps.explanation: Divide double integral by area of region.
